issues.title: Minimum thickness 0.5 mm
issues.message: Thinnest wall is 0.17 mm (limit 0.50 mm), across about 507.1 mm² of the part. Walls this thin may print with gaps or not at all.
issues.suggestion: Thicken thin walls, fins and plates to at least 0.5 mm — 1.2 mm or more for strength.

issues.title: No large spidery pieces
issues.message: This is a large part made of thin, spread-out arms (average thickness about 1.56 mm, fills 8% of its outline). Parts like this warp, break and are hard to ship.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the arms, add connecting webs, or split it into sturdier pieces.

issues.title: Requires Support
issues.message: About 1072 mm² of overhangs (35° or less from horizontal) will need support. Highlighted areas show where.
issues.suggestion: Rotate the part so fewer surfaces face downward, or add chamfers under overhangs.

issues.title: 1 mm bottom chamfer
issues.message: Recommend adding 1mm chamfer to the base of all parts for maximum reliability and highest tolerance.

issues.title: No thin vertical stalks
issues.message: A column about 3.2 mm wide and 22.5 mm tall (7.1× taller than wide) may wobble while printing and snap off during handling.
issues.suggestion: Thicken the column to at least 2 mm, add a fillet or brace at its base, or print it lying down.

issues.title: Closed, solid mesh
issues.message: The model has 1 open edge and 1 non-manifold edge, so it is not a sealed solid. The slicer may fill it wrongly or skip parts of it.
issues.suggestion: Close the holes in your CAD tool or run a repair (e.g. Windows 3D Builder, PrusaSlicer 'Repair', or Meshmixer 'Make Solid') and re-export.
